person.note: He was the son of Tippādhvarin, one of the recipients of the land donation at Thiruvisanallur, and so was a native of Thiruvisanallur. See A Descriptive Catalogue of the Sanskrit Manuscripts in the Sarasvati Mahal Library, Tanjore (Tanjore). Vols. 1–19: Vol. 8, p. 3371.

He was the younger contemporary of Cokkanāthamakhin, hence the name of this entry (Cokkanāthamakhin younger). See A Descriptive Catalogue of the Sanskrit Manuscripts in the Sarasvati Mahal Library, Tanjore (Tanjore). Vols. 1–19: vol. 8, p. xxxi–xxxii.
